'''Dagg''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In that [[Time/Legends|time]], they resided on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], working in the [[Mandalorian enclave]] in [[Kaas City]], where they provided training to other [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]]. While in the enclave, Dagg wore a set of [[Color/Legends|blue]] and white [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on their right hip and a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] on their left wrist. The Nikto's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] could project a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic screen]] from the right wrist. He had green skin, green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and [[Language/Legends|spoke]] [[Nikto (language)|Nikto]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dagg first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying game]]. In the game, they serve as a class trainer for the Imperial bounty hunter class.<ref name="TOR" />
